description: (0.5.0) Feed visibility no wider than retrieval (RFC-ACDP-0018 §5.5; RFC-ACDP-0008 §4.5; RFC-ACDP-0005 §2.5). Behavioral, registry-side.

input.setup: Producer P: public X retracted; restricted Y (audience [A]) retracted; private Z retracted; public W superseded by restricted W2 (audience [A]); 200 hidden changes follow, then one public retraction.

expected.behavior: Anonymous sees X's retraction only; never Y, Z or the W→W2 entry.
A sees X, Y and the W→W2 entry; not Z.

scenarios.name: D — empty page is not the end

expected.behavior: Anonymous with limit=100 past X gets changes: [] with has_more: true until it reaches the final public retraction; pagination never ends early.
A cursor issued to A and replayed anonymously yields only anonymous-visible entries; no hidden seq or count is inferable from the cursor.
